example_sentences_in_bangla: তার থোঁতা মুখ দেখে বুঝলাম সে খুব অহঙ্কারী।
থোঁতা মুখ করে সে কথা বলতে চায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: From his puffed-up face, I could tell he was very arrogant.
He refuses to speak with a haughty expression.
note: The idiom visually describes a pouting or swollen-lipped face as a metaphor for arrogance in Bengali culture.
